text:
An explosion in a nuclear reactor spread the isotope caesium-137 across a large area.
Ninety years after the explosion, the quantity of caesium-137 present will be 12.5% of its original
level.
What is the half-life of caesium-137?
A
11.25 years
B
22.5 years
C
30.0 years
D
45.0 years
subject: Physics
